comment: N/V (not verifiable from the package) fields per autolab package. The verifier fails unless a package's N/V fields equal its entry, and every package needs an entry. An export pull request adds its package's entry, written with scripts/verify_autolab_packages.py --package <dir> --update-baseline, so that the reviewer sees the N/V list in the diff.
